sources.name: pvec
sources.reason: Actual pinned PVec is adapted as dense rows with an explicit exact key index and arc ownership for cross-thread retained views. Flat/tree/Rrb/Rb modes and a common COW Vec control are measured with standard/fast builders; branch factors 32 and 4 use separately verified compiler artifacts. Conversion, index copying and indexed borrowed traversal costs are included. Native API proofs at 20,000 records cover old views, four readers, clone/pop failures and final tracked-value release. Each v28/v29 complete-engine panel passes 10,902 small proofs, 10,902 matching-output parallel selections and the selected 1,650 full-size scalar proofs. Full-size generic and per-configuration threaded phases are running. Isolated/final holdout acceptance remains pending; observed losses are retained. These are configurations of one actual vector library, not independent library counts. The branch32 v28 panel now also completes all 7,040 selected generic full-size and 1,980 scalar/generic threaded proofs. Its full-size/threaded aggregate is independently audited at 10,670 processes. Branch4 generic/threaded admission remains in progress.

sources.name: mvcc-core
sources.reason: Actual mvcc-core 0.1.0 is adapted through two owner-thread native transaction policies and six explicitly charged transferable-export policies, not eight independent libraries. The 22-engine scalar panel passes 660 small and 660 full-size state/revision/ordered-feed checks, 88 actual four-reader probes and 660 matching-output parallel selections. Eight edge probes check precommit capture rollback, duplicate/absent-delete feeds, gap/future boundaries, old values, empty revisions and active transaction release. Native sessions use Rc/RefCell handles on the owning thread, with new transactions created on reader threads for threading probes; their handle acquisition is not a Send/Sync snapshot score. Exports scan own staged writes into a map before commit, charging native scan/capture/allocation costs and avoiding an authoritative shadow map. Generic scoped/exported payloads, instrumented native reclamation, isolated comparisons and final admission remain pending. No superiority or sockets claim.
